purpose: Size the Song_DACFC_Pin_3 amplifier using the permitted parameters. Meet all eight fixed nominal DC, AC, and transient requirements within 30 evaluations. The joint requirements are project-defined for this released circuit adaptation.

paper.title: Dual Active-Capacitive-Feedback Compensation for Low-Power Large-Capacitive-Load Three-Stage Amplifiers

design_context.circuit_description: Dual active feedback branches, two capacitors, auxiliary PMOS gma1/gma2 groups; one capacitor is shunt net4 to ground. PMOS gmf1 pair supplements main input stage. These circuit roles follow the released AnalogGym schematic and netlist. Original-paper review was limited to the abstract and author bibliography; the original full text and original schematic were unavailable.
